system.description:
Even fire and sunlight, the great banes of the Cainites, rarely mark you; you can endure for a brief time punishment that would reduce others to ash.

When you suffer aggravated damage you may immediately make a Simple Test to reduce its severity, turning one level of aggravated damage into lethal on a win. Before testing you may expend a stamina-related Physical Trait, which lets you succeed on a win or a tie; otherwise you must win outright. Use of Resilience is reflexive and costs no action. You may attempt it only once against any given attack, so from an attack dealing two or more levels of aggravated damage you can reduce only a single level to lethal.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
